stem.text: The diagram shows the relative abundance of different isotopes of lead in a sample of lead ore. The abundance of 208 is half that of 206. The abundances of 208 and 209 are equal.

stem.alt: Bar chart of % abundance against mass number A_r for lead isotopes: 206 at 50%, 207 absent, 208 at 25%, 209 at 25%.

stem.text: What is the relative atomic mass of the lead in the sample?
